verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no native saved-search, alert, or notification feature. The closest support is the API, which advertises 'automated searches' and 'up-to-date peer-reviewed citations' for custom workflows, plus publication-year filters. A researcher could therefore build their own standing search outside the app. Missing for 10: a native saved or standing search feature, alerts or notifications when new matching papers appear, evidence of how quickly new papers reach the index, and any hands-on corroboration.
